budget.description: The weekly cap, per-eval-run cap and stop line for automatic evals, copied from skills-evals evals/budget.yml on main. Saved as a file because the GitHub connector returns only a short status line to the page, not the file's text.
budget.schedule: Rebuilt on every refresh, read from evals/budget.yml
budget.title: Eval budget settings

checkins.description: One-time reminders Claude set in this project, from the scheduled task list.
checkins.title: Scheduled check-ins

cost_benefit_summary.description: The system's use (eval runs and scheduled tasks in approximate points, API credit in dollars) per decided verdict, decision yield, real-work reach, the Dec 15 bars and the dollars-per-point rates; rows in group development cover project threads apart. Built by Claude with the weekly rows.
cost_benefit_summary.title: Cost and benefit, summary

cost_benefit_weeks.description: Per week (Monday 5 PM UTC to the next): eval runs and their approximate points, scheduled-task points (estimated from each task's runs a week and median run cost, from the first fire-ledger week), their sum, API-billed eval dollars (API credit), development (project-thread) points apart, loop changes merged, real-work uses of changed skills and guidance, and your messages. Built by Claude from the project's session costs, the fire ledger, your message times, merged loop PRs and the results branch. Development leaves out every session the fire ledger records as a scheduled-task run.
cost_benefit_weeks.title: Cost and benefit, by week

eval_allowance.description: Eval use over the last 7 days and the latest account meter reading, worked out with skills-evals' own allowance guard code from the results branch. It does not count fires still running.
eval_allowance.title: Eval allowance snapshot

eval_ingests.description: The newest commits on skills-evals' results branch, one per finished eval run. Reads the persistent/eval-results branch history.
eval_ingests.title: Latest saved eval runs

half_built_issues.description: Open findings from the weekly check for half-built or broken features across the fleet's repos, plus any fixed in the last 7 days: repo, kind, severity, title, link and age. Built by Claude from the check's GitHub issues.
half_built_issues.title: Half-built and broken features, findings

half_built_summary.description: One row on the check itself: when it last ran, whether its search hit a limit, and its status. The counts come from the findings rows. Built by Claude with the findings rows.
half_built_summary.title: Half-built and broken features, summary

merged_prs.description: The 30 most recently updated merged pull requests in the same four repos. Reads GitHub pull request search.
merged_prs.title: Recently merged PRs

open_issues.description: Open issues in skills-evals, _agent-guidance, adam-agentskills and claude-memory-map. Reads GitHub issue lists, one call per repo.
open_issues.title: Open issues

open_prs.description: Open pull requests in skills-evals, _agent-guidance, adam-agentskills and claude-memory-map. Reads GitHub pull request search, then each PR's head branch, check runs and commit statuses.
open_prs.title: Open PRs

roster.description: Which models the evals run on, judge with and quick-check with, read by Claude from skills-evals evals/roster.yml on main, plus models dropped in the last change.
roster.schedule: Rebuilt on every refresh, read from evals/roster.yml
roster.title: Models on the roster

routines.description: The project's automatic jobs and their last runs, read by Claude from the scheduled task list and project threads, with each scheduled task's runs a week and approximate points a run and a week from the fire ledger.
routines.title: Routines

run_stream.description: GitHub Actions runs in the attached repos and scheduled-task runs from the last 7 days, gathered by Claude's watcher every hour.
run_stream.title: Run console

threads.description: The threads in this project and their state, from the project's thread list.
threads.title: Project threads

usage_rows.description: Weekly counts of skill uses and git hook check runs, blocks and bypasses, per repo and place, with PR outcomes where CI reports them. Concatenated by Claude from skills-evals persistent/eval-results usage/weekly-*.json (schema 1). Empty until the first file lands.
usage_rows.title: Real-work use, weekly

usage_sources.description: The sources each usage file counted: where, scope, time span and sessions read.
usage_sources.title: Real-work use sources

waiting.description: Items only you can do or decide: open issues and PRs labeled needs-owner, environment reviews waiting on the current head of an open PR, threads waiting on your answer, cleanup items that need you, and a short manual list. Built by dashboard/build.py in skills-evals.
waiting.title: Waiting on you

explorer.description: The public evals document, explorer/latest.json on skills-evals' persistent/eval-results branch, uploaded unchanged: every public git hook check, skill, guidance section, eval run, lesson, fixture request and activity row. The page's Summary, Hooks, skills and guidance, Loop, Impact and Operations groups all read it.
explorer.title: Evals document

explorer_private.description: Optional. Private-skill results in the same schema as the evals document, kept in adam-agentskills-private, never published. The page merges its skills and eval runs in with a Private badge; until it is uploaded the page shows public targets only.
explorer_private.schedule: Rebuilt on every refresh, read from the private results branch
explorer_private.title: Private-skill results (optional)

refresh.description: When this refresh ran and how often refreshes are due, so the page can warn when one did not land. Always uploaded, changed or not.
refresh.title: Refresh clock
